Packers' Jayden Reed and Zach Bako-Bewele Injured Early vs. Jets

Green Bay Packers wide receiver Jayden Reed was carted off the field with an injury during the second play of the game against the New York Jets. Teammate Zach Bako-Bewele also sustained an injury within the first three plays of the same game.
